title: Meem sakinah: the three rules: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-'Alaq 13 to 19, At-Tin and meem sakinah
source: Written for quran/y3 lesson 19 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Meem sakinah rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 19. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: What is meem sakinah?
points: A meem with no vowel: مْ
Often at the end of a word: لَمْ، عَلَيْهِمْ
The next letter decides how we say it

head: Next letter
Rule
What we do
rows: Lips lightly closed, hum two counts
Merge into the next meem, hum two counts
Say the meem clearly, no extra hum

head: Not this
This
rows: Meem sakinah has four rules like the noon
Meem sakinah has three rules: ikhfa before ب, idgham before م, izhar before the rest

keywords.def: a meem with no vowel (a sukoon or no mark)
hiding the meem before baa, lips closed, with ghunnah
merging meem into meem, with ghunnah
saying the meem clearly before every other letter

questions.a: Izhar shafawi: the next letter is hamza (أ), not ب or م.

questions.q: Rule sort (pupil PDF): put «أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ» (94:1), «يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ» (96:14), «رَبِّهِم مِّن» (97:4) under the right rule. Today's rota group recites 96:13 to 16 to the teacher.
questions.a: Izhar: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ; ikhfa: يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ; idgham: رَبِّهِم مِّن.

questions.q: Extend: write the three rules and their letters from memory.
questions.a: Ikhfa shafawi: ب; idgham shafawi: م; izhar shafawi: all other letters.

questions.q: Stretch: why is izhar shafawi extra important before و and ف?
questions.a: Because و and ف are also made with the lips, so we must not hide the meem: say it clearly.

questions.q: In «يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ» (96:14) the meem is followed by ب. Which rule?
questions.a: A) Ikhfa shafawi. Meem sakinah before ب is ikhfa shafawi: lips lightly closed, hum two counts.

questions.q: Think again: Close your lips and hum 'mmm'. Now say 'ham-bur-ger' slowly. What did your lips do on the m before the b?
questions.a: The lips stayed closed and the hum carried into the b. That is like ikhfa shafawi.
